### The Light of the World
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-light-of-the-world
Passage: John 8:12
Points:
- Jesus proclaimed Himself the light of the world in connection with the Feast of Booths, when temple candelabras illuminated Jerusalem.
- His declaration reveals Him as the fulfillment of the wilderness pillar of fire and the Old Testament promise of salvation.
- Although religious leaders challenged His claim, Jesus noted that the Father also bears witness alongside Him.
- Believers must resist seeking guidance in worldly substitutes and instead look solely to the light of Christ.

### What Does Jesus Mean by "I Am the Light of the World" in John 8:12?
Author: Jessica Udall
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-does-jesus-mean-by-i-am-the-light-of-the-world-in-john-.html
Passage: John 8:12
Points:
- In an ancient world marked by unavoidable nighttime darkness, light provided protection, direction, and safety.
- Spoken during the Feast of Tabernacles, Jesus' words present Him as the true source of spiritual clarity out of sin.
- Following Jesus offers believers practical promises, including deliverance from evil, freedom from sin, and peace over fear.
- Those who experience Christ's light are transformed to walk in holiness and reflect His truth to the world.
